title: DesignSetGo per-block agent guidance
description: Shape of a src/blocks/{block}/agent.json file. Hand-written guidance an agent reads before building a page with a block, surfaced by the designsetgo/list-blocks ability's `guidance` field when `detail` is "full". Documentation only — tests/unit/engine/guidance.test.js enforces this shape with a small hand-rolled validator (no schema-validation dependency).

whenToUse.description: One or two sentences: what real-world content this block is for, and when to reach for it over a similar block.

avoid.description: Concrete mistakes to avoid with this block — anti-patterns the engine's lint rules catch, plus block-specific gotchas (required child blocks, attributes that only make sense together, etc.).

title.description: Short label for the example, e.g. "Hero section with CTA".

tree.description: An agent block tree in the engine's contract: { version: 1, blocks: [{ name, attributes, innerBlocks }] }. Must assemble to valid markup (engine.assemble(tree).status === 'valid') and lint clean (zero errors, zero warnings) against the Twenty Twenty-Five design context fixture — CI proves both.
